bookSourceComment:
by 狼崽儿 //2026.8.9
第三方的开放番茄小说API。无法同步账号
1.支持小说，漫画，听书，短剧（但是这个API的短剧资源无法播放，所以实际上只支持前三种模式），默认小说，切换类型在登录切换，别忘了在左上角切换源类型。
2.仅支持小说评论。（其实也支持其他类型的评论，但是阅读会有兼容问题）
3.评论支持看用户名，评论正文，用户评分，点赞数，回复数。但是无法看楼中楼和具体用户信息。
4.评论数默认拉取100条，实测会在100多条的数量变动。如果需要拉取更多评论，在正文的LIMIT处修改数字，但是太多评论会很慢。
5.全面兼容所有版本的阅读
7.无段评，评论为整本书评论
【V2 更新】2026.8.10
去除评论字数限制；采用更加简单的toUrl，提高了解析目录成功率。为文章前面添加空格，优化文章显示效果。
【V3 更新】2026.8.11
重大更新！现已支持所有模式的发现页，只需要在登录处变换男女频道和四大类型就可以更新发现页。如果是旧版阅读，在发现页长按此书源，在下拉列表点击更新。同时优化当前模式的弹窗，支持查看模式，当前频道和评论开关状态。因为拉取评论容易导致校验超时，所以建议平时关掉评论开关。
【V3.1 更新】2026.8.11
支持显示卷名。
此书源为个人用AI整合，主要功能是查找书籍。免费用户仅可阅读前十章，登录并购买官方会员后可解锁全部内容。

  java.log("解析异常：" + err);
  res = [];

  let Vname = item.volume_name;
  let time = item.update_titme;
  let words = item.word_number + "字";
  let Info = `${Vname} | ${time} | ${words}`;
  
  if (item.isCache) {
    Info = "🍓" + Info;
  }

    title: item.title,
    url: path + '/' + item.item_id,
    info: Info
  });
});

chapterList;

    var today = new Date();
    var dateT = today.getFullYear()
        + '-'
        + (today.getMonth() + 1)
        + '-'
        + today.getDate()
        + '_discover_tabs';

    var url = Api('/api/discover/tabs');
    var res = null;
    var cacheData = '';
    var sourceItem = null;
    var result = [];
    var tab;
    var count = 0;
    var i;
    var u;

    try {
        cacheData = cache.get(dateT);

        if (cacheData) {
            try {
                res = JSON.parse(cacheData);
            } catch (e) {
                res = null;
            }
        }

        if (!res) {
            res = JSON.parse(java.ajax(url));

            if (res && res.code == 0) {
                cache.put(dateT, JSON.stringify(res));
            }
        }
    } catch (e) {
        return [{
            title: '数据加载失败，请刷新后重试',
            url: '',
            style: {
                layout_flexGrow: 1,
                layout_flexBasisPercent: 1
            }
        }];
    }

    if (!res || res.code != 0 || !res.data || !res.data.sources) {
        return [{
            title: '请先登陆，登陆后刷新发现页即可',
            url: '',
            style: {
                layout_flexGrow: 1,
                layout_flexBasisPercent: 1
            }
        }];
    }

    for (i = 0; i < res.data.sources.length; i++) {
        if (res.data.sources[i] && res.data.sources[i].name == so) {
            sourceItem = res.data.sources[i];
            break;
        }
    }

    if (!sourceItem || !sourceItem.tabs || sourceItem.tabs.length == 0) {
        return [{
            title: '暂无' + (so || '') + '发现内容',
            url: '',
            style: {
                layout_flexGrow: 1,
                layout_flexBasisPercent: 1
            }
        }];
    }

    for (i = 0; i < sourceItem.tabs.length; i++) {
        tab = sourceItem.tabs[i];

        if (!tab) {
            continue;
        }

        if (tab.section) {
            if (count > 0) {
                while (count < 3) {
                    result.push({
                        title: '--',
                        url: '',
                        style: {
                            layout_flexGrow: 1,
                            layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.25
                        }
                    });
                    count++;
                }
            }

            result.push({
                title: tab.title || '',
                url: '',
                style: {
                    layout_flexGrow: 1,
                    layout_flexBasisPercent: 1
                }
            });

            count = 0;
            continue;
        }

        u = '/api/discover/content?source='
            + encodeURIComponent(sourceItem.source || '')
            + '&tab='
            + encodeURIComponent(tab.key || '')
            + '&page={{page}}&page_size=12';

        result.push({
            title: tab.title || '',
            url: Api(u),
            style: {
                layout_flexGrow: 1,
                layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.25
            }
        });

        count++;

        if (count >= 3) {
            count = 0;
        }
    }

    if (count > 0) {
        while (count < 3) {
            result.push({
                title: '--',
                url: '',
                style: {
                    layout_flexGrow: 1,
                    layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.25
                }
            });

            count++;
        }
    }

    return result;
}

作者: 知秋
1. 使用服务器进行中转，有请求速率限制，小说为一分钟300次，支持小说下载请不要太夸张。
2. 临时token口令为 天一团队是倒狗(qq为1070240776和845646066和1484608559)请勿相信任何需要付费的说法欢迎来官方反馈群举报
3. 获取token请点击登录界面，获取token按钮，点击测试/修改token可查询日下载量，切记获取token后请保存，最后选择√存储成功，token为3日有效期，到期请重新获取，切记token变为明文，请勿外泄，异地登录多次会封禁token，如封禁请等过期重新获取。(token改为明文存源变量中防止丢失)
4. 共享数据库如有，则优先使用数据库，共享章节开头的图标为🍅
5. 支持下载，请把预下载改成0-10之间，请求有超限拉黑，请勿大规模批量下载
6. 搜索类型会随着书源模式改变，听书模式，默认搜索听书
7.   搜索小说：以字母n开头；
      搜索漫画：以字母c开头；
      搜索听书：以字母a开头；
      搜索短剧：以字母v开头；
8. 听小说模式适配ai音色听书，选择此模式刷新发现即可，详情页有书籍支持音色，自定义音色听书或者采取下列方式也可(注意听书模式为真人主播，自定义音色无法生效)
    ai配音听书需要a➕bookid搜索即可，默认皆为真人(小说的支持ai音色请看小说详情页简介处的音色即可获得，每个数字代表一个音色)
9. 反馈q群：755947375，token问题群里找我，或者社区找也行(社区不经常在线，上线看到会回)
10. 段评，章评，书评。在登录界面开启关闭
11. 颜色可以在登录界面自行更改
12. 接口请求速率存在限制，请不要大规模下载，耐心等待。

    group_bookids[i.group_name ? i.group_name : "未分组"].push(i.book_id)
  })
  if (!group_bookids[decodeURIComponent(name)]) return { data: [] }
  let book_ids = group_bookids[decodeURIComponent(name)]
  return getBooksInfo(book_ids)

// 标记；这里轮询同 URL（每 2 秒、最长 90 秒）直到拿到真目录。轮询请求全部毫秒级应答，

    var tocBookId = String(queryValue(baseUrl, 'book_id') || GET.call(this, 'bookId') || '').trim();
    var tocPath = '/api/directory?book_id=' + encodeURIComponent(tocBookId) + '&ys_module=' + encodeURIComponent(module) + '&async=1';
    var tocDeadline = Date.now() + 90000;
    while (Date.now() < tocDeadline) {
      try { java.sleep(2000); } catch (eSleep) {}
      tocRaw = String(java.ajax(API.call(this, tocPath)) || '');
      try {
        var tocProbe2 = JSON.parse(tocRaw);
        if (!(tocProbe2 && tocProbe2.data && tocProbe2.data.pyfq_async === 'processing')) break;
      } catch (ePoll1) { break; }

var root = JSON.parse(tocRaw);

// 求值的，807 章 = 807 × 3 次。旧写法把「拼章节链接」放在 chapterUrl 的 @js 里，每章要读
// 5-6 次配置（GET('module') + getHostList 的 getVariable + GET('server') ×2 +

// getChapterList 直接超时。这里把每章需要的链接与更新时间**一次算完写进章节对象**，

var pyfqLinkHead = '';
var pyfqLinkTail = '';
try {
  var pyfqBookId = String(queryValue(baseUrl, 'book_id') || GET.call(this, 'bookId') || '');
  var pyfqTemplate = String(API.call(this, '/api/ping?q=__PYFQ_ITEM__&book_id=' + encodeURIComponent(pyfqBookId) + '&ys_module=' + encodeURIComponent(module)) || '');

var root = JSON.parse(result);
var data = root.data || root || {};
var chapters = data.item_data_list || data.catalog_data || data.item_list || [];
if (!Array.isArray(chapters)) chapters = [];

  try {
    var bookId = queryValue(baseUrl, 'book_id') || GET.call(this, 'bookId');
    var infoById = {};
    var richRoot = requestJSON.call(this, '/api/catalog_rich?book_id=' + encodeURIComponent(bookId));
    var richData = richRoot.data || {};
    var richItems = Array.isArray(richData.items) ? richData.items : (Array.isArray(richData) ? richData : []);
    richItems.forEach(function(item) {
      var id = String(item.item_id || item.group_id || '');
      if (id) infoById[id] = item;
    });
    chapters.forEach(function(chapter) {
      var id = String(chapter.itemId || chapter.item_id || '');
      var info = infoById[id] || {};
      var meta = [];
      var words = Number(info.chapter_word_number || 0);
      if (words > 0) meta.push(words + '字');
      if (Number(info.status || 0) != 0) meta.push('锁定');
      var toneCount = Number(info.tone_count || 0);
      if (!toneCount) {
        var tones = info.tts_info && info.tts_info.tone;

      }

      var title = String(chapter.title || info.title || '');
      var summary = String(info.chapter_abstract || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();

    });

  }
}

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
var module = moduleFromUrl(baseUrl, GET.call(this, 'module') || 3);
book.type = bookTypeForModule(module);
// v0.72 目录分次取：tocUrl 带 async=1，冷目录时 Legado 拿到的是毫秒级的 processing
// 标记；这里轮询同 URL（每 2 秒、最长 90 秒）直到拿到真目录。轮询请求全部毫秒级应答，
// 不触发服务端 30s 写超时；java.sleep 已由主机池探活使用，各宿主可用。
var tocRaw = String(result || '');
try {
  var tocProbe = JSON.parse(tocRaw);
  if (tocProbe && tocProbe.data && tocProbe.data.pyfq_async === 'processing') {
    var tocBookId = String(queryValue(baseUrl, 'book_id') || GET.call(this, 'bookId') || '').trim();
    var tocPath = '/api/directory?book_id=' + encodeURIComponent(tocBookId) + '&ys_module=' + encodeURIComponent(module) + '&async=1';
    var tocDeadline = Date.now() + 90000;
    while (Date.now() < tocDeadline) {
      try { java.sleep(2000); } catch (eSleep) {}
      tocRaw = String(java.ajax(API.call(this, tocPath)) || '');
      try {
        var tocProbe2 = JSON.parse(tocRaw);
        if (!(tocProbe2 && tocProbe2.data && tocProbe2.data.pyfq_async === 'processing')) break;
      } catch (ePoll1) { break; }
    }
  }
} catch (ePoll0) {}
var root = JSON.parse(tocRaw);
var data = root.data || root || {};
var chapters = data.item_data_list || data.catalog_data || data.item_list || [];
if (!Array.isArray(chapters)) chapters = [];

// v0.76 目录阶段「零跨桥」：宿主对 ruleToc 的 chapterName/chapterUrl/updateTime 是**按章**
// 求值的，807 章 = 807 × 3 次。旧写法把「拼章节链接」放在 chapterUrl 的 @js 里，每章要读
// 5-6 次配置（GET('module') + getHostList 的 getVariable + GET('server') ×2 +
// GET('server_check_time') + GET('api_key')）；宿主里每次读都是跨引擎调用（真机 2.6-5ms），
// 807 章就是 4000+ 次 ⇒ 目录阶段实测被拖到 10s 量级，弱宿主 15s 脚本预算被打爆、
// getChapterList 直接超时。这里把每章需要的链接与更新时间**一次算完写进章节对象**，
// 三个逐章字段因此退化为纯 JSONPath（见 normalizeMufanTocRule）。
//
// 拼链接只在这里做一次：仍走 API.call（保留 api_key 追加与线路选择语义），用占位符
// 探出模板再按章替换，避免自己重写 query 拼接顺序而与正文阶段对不上。
var pyfqLinkHead = '';
var pyfqLinkTail = '';
try {
  var pyfqBookId = String(queryValue(baseUrl, 'book_id') || GET.call(this, 'bookId') || '');
  var pyfqTemplate = String(API.call(this, '/api/ping?q=__PYFQ_ITEM__&book_id=' + encodeURIComponent(pyfqBookId) + '&ys_module=' + encodeURIComponent(module)) || '');
  var pyfqParts = pyfqTemplate.split('q=__PYFQ_ITEM__');
  if (pyfqParts.length === 2) { pyfqLinkHead = pyfqParts[0] + 'q='; pyfqLinkTail = pyfqParts[1]; }
} catch (eLink) {}

// 更新时间格式化在 JS 侧做（UTC+8，与 java.timeFormatUTC(...,8) 同格式）：
// 用 java.timeFormatUTC 的话每章都要跨一次桥，又是 807 次。入参是秒，
// 与旧规则 java.getString(...) * 1000 的语义保持一致。
function pyfqFormatUTC8(sec) {
  var n = Number(sec || 0);
  if (!n || isNaN(n)) return '';
  var d = new Date(n * 1000 + 8 * 3600 * 1000);
  if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return '';
  function p2(x) { return (x < 10 ? '0' : '') + x; }
  return d.getUTCFullYear() + '-' + p2(d.getUTCMonth() + 1) + '-' + p2(d.getUTCDate()) +
    ' ' + p2(d.getUTCHours()) + ':' + p2(d.getUTCMinutes()) + ':' + p2(d.getUTCSeconds());
}

if (switchEnabled.call(this, 'richToc') && chapters.length) {
  try {
    var bookId = queryValue(baseUrl, 'book_id') || GET.call(this, 'bookId');
    var infoById = {};
    var richRoot = requestJSON.call(this, '/api/catalog_rich?book_id=' + encodeURIComponent(bookId));
    var richData = richRoot.data || {};
    var richItems = Array.isArray(richData.items) ? richData.items : (Array.isArray(richData) ? richData : []);
    richItems.forEach(function(item) {
      var id = String(item.item_id || item.group_id || '');
      if (id) infoById[id] = item;
    });
    chapters.forEach(function(chapter) {
      var id = String(chapter.itemId || chapter.item_id || '');
      var info = infoById[id] || {};
      var meta = [];
      var words = Number(info.chapter_word_number || 0);
      if (words > 0) meta.push(words + '字');
      if (Number(info.status || 0) != 0) meta.push('锁定');
      var toneCount = Number(info.tone_count || 0);
      if (!toneCount) {
        var tones = info.tts_info && info.tts_info.tone;
        toneCount = Array.isArray(tones) ? tones.length : 0;
      }
      if (toneCount > 0) meta.push(toneCount + '音色');
      var title = String(chapter.title || info.title || '');
      var summary = String(info.chapter_abstract || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
      // 视频/漫画类章节的 chapter_abstract 返回的是 HTML 转义后的媒体元数据
      // （{"duration":...} / {"materials":{"img_0":...}}），不是正文摘要。
      // 直接拼进 richTitle 会让阅读端章节名出现 JSON 残片，这里按结构特征剔除。
      if (summary && (summary.charAt(0) == '{' || summary.charAt(0) == '[' || summary.indexOf('"') >= 0 || summary.indexOf('"duration"') >= 0 || summary.indexOf('"materials"') >= 0)) summary = '';
      if (summary.length > 36) summary = summary.slice(0, 36) + '...';
      chapter.richTitle = title + (meta.length ? '  [' + meta.join(' · ') + ']' : '') + (summary ? '\n' + summary : '');
    });
  } catch (error) {
    java.log('富目录已回退普通目录：' + error);
  }
}

// 逐章预焙 + 精简投影：宿主只在逐章规则里用到 title/richTitle/pyfqUrl/pyfqUpdate 四个字段，
// 原始章节对象的 content_md5/version/chapter_type 等对阅读端毫无用处，却要按字节走一遍弱网
// 下载（807 章 × 每字段都是实打实的时长），因此这里只 JSON.stringify 精简后的对象。
chapters.map(function(chapter) {
  var id = String(chapter.itemId || chapter.item_id || '');
  var item = {
    title: String(chapter.title || ''),
    pyfqUrl: pyfqLinkHead ? (pyfqLinkHead + encodeURIComponent(id) + pyfqLinkTail) : '',
    pyfqUpdate: ''
  };
  var updateText = pyfqFormatUTC8(chapter.first_pass_time || chapter.firstPassTime);
  var volume = String(chapter.volume_name || '').replace(/第一卷：默认/g, '').trim();
  item.pyfqUpdate = volume ? (updateText ? volume + '  | ' + updateText : volume) : updateText;
  if (chapter.richTitle) item.richTitle = String(chapter.richTitle);
  return JSON.stringify(item);
});
</js>

  return d.getFullYear() + "-" + pad(d.getMonth() + 1) + "-" + pad(d.getDate()) + " " + pad(d.getHours()) + ":" + pad(d.getMinutes());

    });

function getBookIdFull(url) {
    const {java} = this;
    let $ = JSON.parse(url).data;
    let arr = [];
    if ($.book_shelf_info && $.book_shelf_info.length > 0) {
        arr = $.book_shelf_info.map(item => item.book_id);
    } else if ($.data_list && $.data_list.length > 0) {
        arr = $.data_list.map(item => item.book_id_str);
    } else {
        java.toast("获取 book_id 失败，你可能需要登录！");
    }
    return arr;
}

let session = getSessionId()

getShelf = () => {
    let book_shelf_info = java.ajax(getServerHost() + "/book_shelf?session=" + session)
    
    bid = getBookIdFull(book_shelf_info)
    
    let id_list = splitArray(bid, 200)
    let urls = []
    id_list.forEach(i => {
        urls.push(getServerHost() +"/detail?book_id=" + i.join(","))
    })
    res = java.ajaxAll(urls)

    let resp = {book_info: []}
    res.forEach(r => {
        resp.book_info = resp.book_info.concat(JSON.parse(r.body()).data)
    })

    return resp
}

function getByGroupName(name) {
    let book_shelf_info = JSON.parse(java.ajax(getServerHost() +"/book_shelf?session=" + session))
    
    let group_bookids = {
        "未分组": []
    }
    book_shelf_info.data.book_shelf_info.forEach(i => {
        if (!group_bookids[i.group_name ? i.group_name : "未分组"]) group_bookids[i.group_name] = []
        group_bookids[i.group_name ? i.group_name : "未分组"].push(i.book_id)
    })
    
    if (!group_bookids[decodeURIComponent(name)]) return {data: []}
    
    let book_ids = splitArray(group_bookids[decodeURIComponent(name)], 200)
    let urls = []

    book_ids.forEach(i => { 	urls.push(getServerHost() +"/detail?book_id=" + i.join(","))
    })
    
    res = java.ajaxAll(urls)

    let resp = {book_info: []}
    res.forEach(r => {
        resp.book_info = resp.book_info.concat(JSON.parse(r.body()).data)
    })

    return resp
}

function getByTabIndex(index) {
    let url = _mlsec.requestHeader(
        "bookmall/tab",
        "version_name=5.8.9.32",
        null,
        "sessionid=" + session
    )
    let all = JSON.parse(java.ajax(url))
    let tab = all.data.tab_item[0].cell_data[index].cell_data
    if (!tab) tab = []
    let bookList = []
    for (let i of tab) {
        bookList = bookList.concat(i.book_data)
    }
    return { book_info: bookList }
}

function getGuessYouLike() {
    let apiUrl = 'https://reading.snssdk.com/reading/bookapi/bookmall/tab/v/?version_name=5.8.9.32&device_id=1024&device_type=114514&iid=2048&aid=1967&channel=0&os_version=0&app_name=novelapp&version_code=58932&device_platform=android'
    let response = java.ajax(apiUrl + ', ' + JSON.stringify({
        headers: {
            'Cookie': "sessionid=" + session
        }
    }))
    let responseData = JSON.parse(response)
    let finalResult = {
        code: 0,
        message: 'SUCCESS',
        data: {
            cell_view: {
                book_data: []
            }
        }
    }
    if (responseData.data && responseData.data.tab_item && responseData.data.tab_item.length > 0 && responseData.data.tab_item[0].cell_data && responseData.data.tab_item[0].cell_data.length > 0 && responseData.data.tab_item[0].cell_data[0].cell_data && responseData.data.tab_item[0].cell_data[0].cell_data.length > 0 && responseData.data.tab_item[0].cell_data[0].cell_data[0].book_data) {
        finalResult.data.cell_view.book_data = responseData.data.tab_item[0].cell_data[0].cell_data[0].book_data
    }
    return finalResult
}

function normalizeResponse(data) {
    if (data.data && data.data.book_list && Array.isArray(data.data.book_list)) {
        return data.data.book_list;
    }
    
    if (data.book_info) return data.book_info;
    if (data.data && data.data.book_info) return data.data.book_info;
    if (data.data && Array.isArray(data.data)) return data.data;
    if (data.list) return data.list;
    if (data.book_list) return data.book_list;
    if (data.data && data.data.publication_list) return data.data.publication_list;
    if (data.result) return data.result;
    if (data.data && data.data.result) return data.data.result;
    if (data.data && data.data.cell_view && data.data.cell_view.book_data) {
        return data.data.cell_view.book_data;
    }
    if (data.data && data.data.records) return data.data.records;
    if (data.data && data.data.list) return data.data.list;
    
    return [];
}

if (baseUrl.includes("jj_signin")) {
    let decodedToken = java.base64Decode(JJtoken());
    let timestamp = Date.now();
    let enbody = timestamp + ':' + decodedToken;
    let encodedEnbody = encode(enbody);
    
    let signUrl = "https://android.jjwxc.net/androidapi/signin,{\"method\":\"POST\",\"body\":\"versionCode=507&sign=" + encodedEnbody + "\"}";
    
    let signinResult = java.ajax(signUrl);
    
    let result = JSON.parse(signinResult);
    let message = result.message || "签到请求完成";
    
    let responseData = {
        "isSuccess": result.code == "200",
        "errorMsg": result.code == "200" ? "success" : "fail",
        "data": [{
            "title": message
        }]
    };
    
    JSON.stringify(responseData);
} else if (baseUrl.includes("jjbookshelf")) {
    let token = JJtoken();
    let config = getConfig.call(this);
    let latestType = config.type_id || '';
    let jjUrl = baseUrl.replace(/type=[^&]*/, 'type=' + latestType);
    if (!/type=/.test(jjUrl)) {
        jjUrl += (jjUrl.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + 'type=' + latestType;
    }
    jjUrl = jjUrl + token;
    result = JSON.parse(java.ajax(jjUrl));
    JSON.stringify(result);
} else if (baseUrl.includes("type_style")) {
    let sortKey = getSortKey() || '';
    let newUrl = baseUrl + sortKey;
    result = JSON.parse(java.ajax(newUrl));
    
    let normalizedData = normalizeResponse(result);
    JSON.stringify({data: normalizedData});
} else if (baseUrl.endsWith("bookshelf")) {
    result = getShelf("bookshelf/info")
} else if(/read_history/.test(baseUrl)) {
    let pageMatch = baseUrl.match(/page=(\d+)/);
    let page = pageMatch ? pageMatch[1] : '1';
    
    let history_response = java.ajax(getServerHost() + "/read_history?session=" + session + "&page=" + page)
    let history_data = JSON.parse(history_response)
    
    if (history_data.data.data_list) {
        let book_ids = history_data.data.data_list.map(item => item.book_id_str)
        
        let id_list = splitArray(book_ids, 200)
        let urls = []
        id_list.forEach(i => {
          urls.push(getServerHost() +"/detail?book_id=" + i.join(","))
        })
        
        let resp = {book_info: []}
        urls.forEach(url => {
            let detailResponse = java.ajax(url)
            let detailData = JSON.parse(detailResponse)
            if (detailData.data) {
                resp.book_info = resp.book_info.concat(detailData.data)
            }
        })
        
        result = resp
    } else {
        result = {book_info: []}
    }
} else if (baseUrl.includes("style_top")) {
    result = JSON.parse(result);
} else if (baseUrl.includes("/tab/cai")) {
    result = getGuessYouLike();
} else {
    let w = baseUrl.split("/")
    if (baseUrl.includes("groupName")) {
        result = getByGroupName(w[w.length - 1])
    } else if (baseUrl.includes("tab")) {
        result = getByTabIndex(parseInt(w[w.length - 1]))
    } else {
        result = JSON.parse(result)
        if (result.data && result.data.data) {
            result = {book_info: result.data.data}
        }
    }
}

if (!baseUrl.includes("jjbookshelf") && !baseUrl.includes("type_style") && !baseUrl.includes("jj_signin")) {
    let normalizedData = normalizeResponse(result);
    JSON.stringify({data: normalizedData})
}
</js>

<js>
function login() {
  try{if(java.upLoginData)java.upLoginData();}catch(e){}
  var map = source.getLoginInfoMap();
  var apikey = '';
  try {
    if (typeof map.get === 'function') apikey = map.get('API密钥') || '';
  } catch(e) {}
  if (!apikey) {
    try{java.toast('请输入密钥');}catch(e){}
    return;
  }
  // 同时存到变量（header 读取用）和登录头（UI 显示用）
  var data = {};
  try { data = JSON.parse(source.getVariable() || '{}'); } catch(e) {}
  data['apikey'] = apikey;
  try { source.setVariable(JSON.stringify(data)); } catch(e) {}
  try { source.putLoginHeader('apikey=' + apikey); } catch(e) {}
  try{java.toast('密钥已保存: ' + apikey.substring(0, 8) + '...');}catch(e){}
}
</js>

<js>
// ===== 工具函数 =====
function absUrl(u){
  if(/^https?:/i.test(u)) return u;
  var m = String(baseUrl || '').match(/^(https?:\/\/[^\/]+)/);
  return (m ? m[1] : '') + u;
}
function numOf(u){
  var m = String(u).match(/-(\d+)(?:-\d+)?\.html$/);
  return m ? parseInt(m[1], 10) : 0;
}
function _p2(n){ return (n < 10 ? "0" : "") + n; }
function edgeHeaders(){
  var d = new Date();
  var t = String(d.getFullYear()).slice(2) + _p2(d.getMonth()+1) + _p2(d.getDate());
  return {
    "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/148.0.0.0 Safari/537.36 Edg/148.0.0.0",
    "X-Requested-With": "cn.mujiankeji.mbrowser",
    "Cookie": "k=" + t + ";",
    "Upgrade-Insecure-Requests": "1",
    "Accept": "text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,image/apng,*/*;q=0.8,application/signed-exchange;v=b3;q=0.7",
    "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"
  };
}
function encBody(text, sk, iv){
  try {
    return java.createSymmetricCrypto("aes/cbc/pkcs7padding", java.strToBytes(sk), java.strToBytes(iv)).encryptBase64(text);
  } catch(e) {}
  try {
    var key = Packages.javax.crypto.spec.SecretKeySpec(java.strToBytes(sk), "AES");
    var ivi = Packages.javax.crypto.spec.IvParameterSpec(java.strToBytes(iv));
    var ci = Packages.javax.crypto.Cipher.getInstance("AES/CBC/PKCS5Padding");
    ci.init(Packages.javax.crypto.Cipher.ENCRYPT_MODE, key, ivi);
    return Packages.java.util.Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(ci.doFinal(java.strToBytes(text)));
  } catch(e) { return ""; }
}
function ajaxPost(url, body){
  // 与参考版一致：普通 java.ajax，不加特殊请求头（手机UA即可，被WAF拦会自动回退）
  try {
    return String(java.ajax(url + ',' + JSON.stringify({method: 'POST', body: body})) || '');
  } catch(e) { return ''; }
}

// ===== 第1页章节：兼容 人人书城/爱书库(chapListBody) 与 书友社(chapterList) =====
var hrefs = [], names = [];
try { hrefs = java.getStringList('class.chapListBody@li@a@href') || []; } catch(e) {}
try { names = java.getStringList('class.chapListBody@li@a@text') || []; } catch(e) {}
if(hrefs.length === 0){
  try { hrefs = java.getStringList('class.chapterList@class.list@li@div.name@a@href') || []; } catch(e) {}
  try { names = java.getStringList('class.chapterList@class.list@li@div.name@a@text') || []; } catch(e) {}
}
var out = [];
for(var i = 0; i < hrefs.length; i++){
  var u = absUrl(hrefs[i]);
  out.push({name: names[i] || '', url: u, order: numOf(u)});
}

// ===== 解析 id / 分页数 / AES密钥 =====
var id = '';
try {
  var mid = String(baseUrl || '').match(/\/(?:chapter|book)\/([^\/.?]+?)(?:-\d+)?\.html/);
  if(mid) id = mid[1];
} catch(e) {}
var pageCount = 0;
try {
  var opts = java.getElements('[data-aid="' + id + '"]@option') || [];
  if(opts.length === 0) opts = java.getElements('[data-aid="' + id + '"]@li') || [];
  pageCount = opts.length;
} catch(e) {}
var secretKey = '', ivKey = '';
try {
  var src = String(result || '');
  var mjs = src.match(/<script[^>]*src="([^"]*\/([A-Za-z0-9]{32,})\.js)"[^>]*>/);
  if(mjs){
    var jsTxt = String(java.ajax(absUrl(mjs[1])) || '');
    var mk = jsTxt.match(/AESCrypt\('([^']+)'\)/);
    var mik = jsTxt.match(/parse\('([^']+)'\)/);
    if(mk) secretKey = mk[1];
    if(mik) ivKey = mik[1];
  }
} catch(e) {}

// ===== 拉取其余页（java.post + Edge头） =====
var fetched = false;
if(id && pageCount > 1 && secretKey && ivKey){
  try {
    var baseHost = String(baseUrl || '').match(/^(https?:\/\/[^\/]+)/);
    baseHost = baseHost ? baseHost[1] : '';
    for(var p = 2; p <= pageCount; p++){
      try {
        var body = JSON.stringify({id: id, page: p});
        var enc = encBody(body, secretKey, ivKey);
        if(!enc) break;
        var resp = ajaxPost(baseHost + '/index.php?action=loadChapterPage', 'data=' + encodeURIComponent(enc));
        var obj = JSON.parse(resp);
        if(obj && obj.code === 0 && obj.data && obj.data.length){
          for(var j = 0; j < obj.data.length; j++){
            var it = obj.data[j];
            var u2 = absUrl(it.chapterurl || '');
            out.push({name: it.chaptername || '', url: u2, order: parseInt(it.chapterorder, 10) || numOf(u2) || 0});
          }
          fetched = true;
        } else { break; }
      } catch(e) { break; }
      try { Packages.java.lang.Thread.sleep(800 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 500)); } catch(e) {}
    }
  } catch(e) {}
}

// ===== 去重 + 升序 =====
var seen = {}, list = [];
for(var i = 0; i < out.length; i++){
  var k = out[i].order || out[i].url;
  if(seen[k]) continue;
  seen[k] = 1;
  list.push(out[i]);
}
list.sort(function(a, b){ return (a.order || 0) - (b.order || 0); });

// ===== 分页失败：用总章数占位补齐（不重复） =====
if(!fetched && id && list.length > 0){
  try {
    var bu = (typeof book !== 'undefined' && book && book.bookUrl) ? book.bookUrl : absUrl('/book/' + id + '.html');
    var detail = String(java.ajax(bu) || '');
    var mt = detail.match(/og:novel:latest_chapter_name"\s+content="第(\d+)章/);
    if(!mt) mt = detail.match(/\((\d+)章节\)/);
    var total = mt ? parseInt(mt[1], 10) : 0;
    var have = {};
    for(var i = 0; i < list.length; i++){ have[list[i].order] = 1; }
    for(var n = 1; n <= total; n++){
      if(!have[n]){
        list.push({name: '第' + n + '章', url: absUrl('/book/' + id + '-' + n + '.html'), order: n});
      }
    }
    list.sort(function(a, b){ return (a.order || 0) - (b.order || 0); });
  } catch(e) {}
}

var res = [];
for(var i = 0; i < list.length; i++){
  res.push(JSON.stringify({name: list[i].name, url: list[i].url, order: list[i].order}));
}
if(res.length === 0 && id){
  res.push(JSON.stringify({name: '第1章', url: absUrl('/book/' + id + '-1.html'), order: 1}));
}
res;
</js>

得奇小说网 www.deqixs.org（杰奇CMS架构，UTF-8）
· 搜索：POST精确书名，唯一命中302直达详情页，多命中返回列表页，规则已用||兼容两种结构
· 目录：详情页内嵌目录（id.list），超长书籍目录分页（如玄鉴仙族1585章分2页），已配置nextTocUrl自动翻页，末页href=#已用##^#$##净化防重复

function qmVideoState(kind) {

    var state = saved ? JSON.parse(String(saved)) : null
    if (state && state.pages) return state
  } catch (e) {}
  return {pages:{}}
}

function qmVideoUploadIds(kind, page) {
  page = String(Number(page || 1) || 1)
  if (page == '1') {
    qmResetVideoState.call(this, kind)
    return []
  }
  var state = qmVideoState.call(this, kind)
  var ids = []
  Object.keys(state.pages || {}).sort(function (a, b) { return Number(a) - Number(b) }).forEach(function (key) {
    if (Number(key) < Number(page)) ids = ids.concat(state.pages[key] || [])
  })
  var seen = {}
  return ids.filter(function (id) { id = String(id); if (!id || seen[id]) return false; seen[id] = 1; return true }).slice(-120).map(function (id) {
    return {id:String(id),item_type:kind == 'animated' ? '14' : '11',ts:String(Date.now()),type:'0'}
  })
}

function qmRememberVideoPage(kind, page, items) {
  var runtimeCache = qmCacheOf(this)
  if (!runtimeCache) return items
  page = String(Number(page || 1) || 1)
  var state = qmVideoState.call(this, kind)
  var prior = {}
  Object.keys(state.pages || {}).forEach(function (key) {
    if (key != page) (state.pages[key] || []).forEach(function (id) { prior[String(id)] = 1 })
  })
  var current = []
  var local = {}
  var filtered = items.filter(function (item) {
    var id = qmItemId(item, 'video')
    if (!id || local[id] || prior[id]) return false
    local[id] = 1
    current.push(String(id))
    return true
  })
  state.pages[page] = current
  Object.keys(state.pages).forEach(function (key) { if (Number(key) < Number(page) - 8) delete state.pages[key] })
  runtimeCache.putMemory('qm-video-pages-' + kind, JSON.stringify(state))
  return filtered
}

function qmCollectExplore(node, mode, output, seen, depth) {

  var id = qmItemId(node, itemMode)
  if (id && String(id) != '0' && qmIsCandidate(node, itemMode)) {

    if (!seen[key]) {
      seen[key] = 1
      output.push(qmNormalizeBook.call(ctx, node, itemMode, mode))

  }
  Object.keys(node).forEach(function (key) {
    if (!/^(meta|stat_params|track_id|tag_items|category_list|rank_list)$/.test(key)) {
      qmCollectExplore.call(ctx, node[key], mode, output, seen, depth + 1)

function qmDateText(value) {

  return date.getFullYear() + '-' + two(date.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + two(date.getDate()) + ' ' + two(date.getHours()) + ':' + two(date.getMinutes())
}

function qmNovelInfo(raw) {
  raw = raw || {}

  Object.keys(raw).forEach(function (key) { info[key] = raw[key] })
  var tags = (raw.book_tag_list || []).map(function (x) { return String(x.title || '') }).filter(function (x) { return !!x })
  var attribute = raw.attribute || {}
  var extras = attribute.extra_info_list || []
  function findExtra(pattern) {
    for (var i = 0; i < extras.length; i++) {
      if (pattern.test(String(extras[i].sub_title || extras[i].title || ''))) return qmExtraInfoText(extras[i])
    }
    return ''
  }
  var score = attribute.score || findExtra(/评分|评价/)
  if (score && String(score).indexOf('分') < 0) score = String(score) + '分'
  var reading = ''
  var readingList = attribute.reading_info_list || []
  if (readingList.length > 2) reading = qmExtraInfoText(readingList[2]) || String(readingList[2].title || readingList[2].text || '')
  if (!reading) reading = findExtra(/正在阅读|在线/)
  var lines = []
  var updated = qmDateText(raw.update_time)
  if (updated) lines.push('🧭 更新：' + updated)
  if (raw.category_over_words) lines.push('📒 关于：' + raw.category_over_words)
  if (score) lines.push('💯 分数：' + score)
  if (reading) lines.push('👁️ 在线：' + reading)
  if (tags.length) lines.push('🏷️ 标签：' + tags.join(' / '))
  if (raw.characters) lines.push('👥 角色：' + raw.characters)
  if (raw.publisher) lines.push('🏢 出版：' + raw.publisher)
  if (raw.isbn) lines.push('🔖 ISBN：' + raw.isbn)
  var copyright = raw.statement || raw.source_name
  if (copyright) lines.push('📍 版权来源：' + copyright)
  if (raw.intro) lines.push('📄 简介：' + raw.intro)
  info.id = String(raw.id || '')
  info.author = raw.author || raw.author_name || ''
  info.image_link = raw.big_image_link || raw.image_link || raw.thumb_image_link || ''
  info.intro = lines.join('\n')
  info.kind = [raw.category_over_words].concat(tags).filter(function (x) { return !!x }).join(',')
  info.last_chapter = raw.latest_chapter_title || raw.chapter_list_desc || ''
  info.words_num = raw.words_num || raw.word_count || ''
  return info
}

}

function qmCommentPageData(input) {
  try {
    input = input || {}
    var ctx = this
    var cfg = qmCommentConfig.call(ctx)
    var kind = String(input.kind || 'paragraph')
    var cursor = String(input.cursor || '')
    var response
    var data
    var list = []
    var tags = []
    var total = ''
    var next = ''
    if (kind == 'book') {
      var bookId = String(input.bookId || '')
      var bookHot = String(input.hot || '0') == '1'
      var bp = {circle_id:bookId,need_common:'0',tag_id:String(input.tag || '1'),book_id:bookId,sort:bookHot ? '0' : '1'}
      if (cursor) bp.next_id = cursor
      response = qmGet.call(ctx, 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/community/book-evaluates', bp)
      data = response.data || {}
      list = (data.list || []).map(function (x) { return qmCommentItem.call(ctx, x, bookHot, false) })
      var evaluateInfo = data.evaluates_info || {}
      if (!cursor) total = String(evaluateInfo.eval_comment_count || data.comment_count || list.length)
      next = String(data.next_id || '')
      tags = (evaluateInfo.tag_list || data.tag_list || []).map(function (x) { return {id:String(x.id || x.tag_id || '1'),title:String(x.title || x.name || '全部'),count:String(x.count || x.comment_count || '')} })
    } else {
      var hot = String(input.hot || '0') == '1' ? '1' : '0'
      var params = {book_id:String(input.bookId || ''),chapter_id:String(input.chapterId || '')}
      if (kind == 'paragraph') params.paragraph_id = String(input.paragraphId || '')
      params.hot = hot
      if (kind == 'paragraph') params.check_cmt_id = String(input.checkId || '')
      var firstUrl = kind == 'paragraph' ? 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/paragraph/first' : 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/chapter-comment/first'
      var moreUrl = kind == 'paragraph' ? 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/paragraph/more' : 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/chapter-comment/more'
      if (cursor) {
        params.next_id = cursor
        response = qmGet.call(ctx, moreUrl, params)
      } else {
        params.exposed_ids = ''
        params.need_common = hot == '1' ? '1' : '0'
        if (kind == 'chapter') params.extra = ''
        response = qmPostForm.call(ctx, firstUrl, params)
      }
      data = response.data || {}
      if (cursor) {
        list = (data.comment_list || []).map(function (x) { return qmCommentItem.call(ctx, x, false) })
        next = String(data.next_id || '')
      } else {
        var hotZone = data.hot_zone || {}
        var timeZone = data.time_zone || {}
        var hotList = hotZone.comment_list || []
        var timeList = timeZone.comment_list || []
        list = hotList.map(function (x) { return qmCommentItem.call(ctx, x, true) })

function qmOpenComment(kind, bid, cid, pid, heading, checkId) {
  var html = qmCommentHtml.call(this, kind, bid, cid, pid, heading, checkId)
  var cfg = qmCommentConfig.call(this)
  var runtimeJava = qmJavaOf(this)
  if (!qmCallable(runtimeJava, 'showBrowser')) return false
  runtimeJava.showBrowser('https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/', html, 'window.java=java;window.cache=cache;window.source=source;window.qmRun=run;window.qmLocalCommentPage=true;', JSON.stringify({state:4,isHideable:true,heightPercentage:cfg.height,widthPercentage:1.0,dismissOnTouchOutside:true,skipCollapsed:true,expandedCornersRadius:16,isGestureInsetBottomIgnored:true,hardwareAccelerated:true,webViewInitialScale:100}))
  return true
}

function qmSvg(kind, bid, cid, pid, count, label, checkId, hot) {
  var normalizedKind = String(kind || '')
  var cfg = qmCommentConfig.call(this)
  var color = cfg.color
  count = Number(count || 0)
  if (count <= 0) return ''
  if (normalizedKind == 'paragraph' && cfg.split) color = hot ? cfg.hotColor : count >= cfg.splitCount ? cfg.splitColor : cfg.color
  count = Math.min(count, 999)
  var svg
  if (normalizedKind == 'paragraph') {
    var displayText = String(Math.min(count, 999))
    var custom = cfg.template == '起点' ? '' : qmLoginValue.call(this, cfg.template.replace('样式', '◎ 气泡'), '')
    svg = custom.trim() ? custom.replace(/\$\{qpyscolor\}/g, color).replace(/\$\{qpwzcolor\}/g, color).replace(/\$\{font\}/g, 'Arial').replace(/\$\{displayText\}/g, displayText) :
      '<svg viewBox="5 14 45 36" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="180" height="144"><path d="M44 48 Q48 48 48 44 L48 20 Q48 16 44 16 L20 16 Q16 16 16 20 L16 24 S16 28 10 30 Q6 32 10 34 Q16 36 16 38 L16 44 Q16 48 20 48 Z" fill="none" stroke="' + color + '" stroke-width="0.7"/><text x="32" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial" font-weight="600" font-size="18" fill="' + color + '" dominant-baseline="middle">' + displayText + '</text></svg>'
  } else if (normalizedKind == 'book' || normalizedKind == 'chapter') {
    svg = '<svg width="1000" height="128" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect x="6" y="6" width="988" height="116" rx="12" fill="none" stroke="' + color + '" stroke-width="3"/><text x="48" y="79" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="38" fill="' + color + '">' + qmEsc(label) + '</text><text x="950" y="79" text-anchor="end" font-family="Arial" font-size="34" fill="' + color + '">' + count + ' 条 ›</text></svg>'
  } else {
    svg = '<svg width="1000" height="800" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect x="150" y="150" width="665" height="525" rx="175" fill="none" stroke="' + color + '" stroke-width="18"/><text x="480" y="535" font-family="Arial" text-anchor="middle" font-size="298" fill="' + color + '">' + count + '</text></svg>'
  }
  var encoded = qmBase64Encode(this, svg)
  if (!encoded) return ''
  var call = 'qmOpenComment.call(this,' + [normalizedKind, bid, cid, pid, label || '', checkId || ''].map(function (x) { return JSON.stringify(String(x || '')) }).join(',') + ')'
  var style = normalizedKind == 'paragraph' ? qmCommentConfig.call(this).svgSize : 'FULL'
  return 'data:image/svg+xml;base64,' + encoded + ',' + JSON.stringify({style:style,type:'qmpl',click:call})
}

function qmBubbleImage(kind, bid, cid, pid, count, label, checkId, hot) {
  var data = qmSvg.call(this, kind, bid, cid, pid, count, label, checkId, hot)
  return data ? '<img src="' + data + '">' : ''
}

function qmGodImage(bid, cid, pid, gid, text) {
  text = String(text || '').replace(/[\r\n]+/g, ' ').trim()
  if (!gid || !text) return ''
  if (text.length > 18) text = text.slice(0, 18) + '...'
  var svg = '<svg width="1000" height="120" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">' +
    '<rect x="2" y="0" width="996" height="100" fill="rgba(255,255,255,0.25)" rx="35" stroke="#888" stroke-width="1"/>' +
    '<rect x="32" y="22" width="140" height="56" rx="20" fill="#FF4444"/>' +
    '<text x="102" y="64" font-size="32" font-family="Segoe UI,Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif" fill="#FFF" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">神评</text>' +
    '<text x="196" y="64" font-size="38" font-family="Segoe UI,Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif" fill="#000" font-weight="bold">' + qmEsc(text) + '</text></svg>'
  var encoded = qmBase64Encode(this, svg)
  if (!encoded) return ''
  var call = 'qmOpenComment.call(this,' + ['paragraph', bid, cid, pid, '七猫神评', gid].map(function (x) { return JSON.stringify(String(x || '')) }).join(',') + ')'
  var data = 'data:image/svg+xml;base64,' + encoded + ',' + JSON.stringify({style:'FULL',type:'qmpl-god',click:call})
  return '<img src="' + data + '">'
}

function qmChapterReviewCount(bid, cid) {
  var runtimeCache = qmCacheOf(this)
  var key = 'qm-count-chapter-' + bid + '-' + cid
  var saved = runtimeCache && runtimeCache.getFromMemory(key)
  if (saved != null) return Number(saved || 0)
  var data = qmGet.call(this, 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v1/comment/chapter-end-comment', {book_id:bid,chapter_ids:cid}).data || {}
  var comments = data.comments || []
  var count = comments.length ? Number(comments[0].count || 0) : 0
  if (runtimeCache) runtimeCache.putMemory(key, String(count))
  return count
}

function qmBookReviewCount(bid) {
  var runtimeCache = qmCacheOf(this)
  var key = 'qm-count-book-' + bid
  var saved = runtimeCache && runtimeCache.getFromMemory(key)
  if (saved != null) return Number(saved || 0)
  var data = qmGet.call(this, 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/community/book-evaluates', {circle_id:bid,need_common:'0',tag_id:'1',book_id:bid,sort:'0'}).data || {}
  var count = Number(data.evaluates_info && data.evaluates_info.eval_comment_count || data.comment_count || 0)
  if (runtimeCache) runtimeCache.putMemory(key, String(count))
  return count
}

function qmNovelContent(text, baseUrl) {
  var ctx = this
  var raw = qmParse(text).data || {}
  var bid = qmUrlValue(baseUrl, 'id')
  var cid = qmUrlValue(baseUrl, 'chapterId')
  var cfg = qmCommentConfig.call(ctx)
  var readerType = qmReaderType(ctx, baseUrl)
  var content = readerType == '3' ? qmEpubRemoteDecrypt.call(ctx, raw.content || '') : qmDecryptChapter(raw.content || '')
  if (!qmCommentsAllowed(ctx, baseUrl)) return content
  var marks = {}
  if (cfg.paragraph || cfg.god) {
    try {
      var bubbleResponse = qmPostForm.call(ctx, 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v1/paragraph/bubbles', {
        book_id:bid,chapters:JSON.stringify([{chapter_id:cid,chapter_md5:String(raw.content_md5 || '')}])
      })
      var chapters = bubbleResponse.data && bubbleResponse.data.chapters || []
      var bubbles = chapters.length ? chapters[0].bubbles || [] : []
      bubbles.forEach(function (item) {
        var count = Number(item.c || 0)
        if (count > 0 || item.gid || item.gtxt) marks[String(item.p)] = {count:count,hot:String(item.hot || '') == '1',gid:String(item.gid || ''),gtxt:String(item.gtxt || '')}
      })
    } catch (bubbleError) {}
  }
  var lines = String(content).split('\n')
  lines.forEach(function (line, index) {
    var pid = qmMd5(line).slice(0, 8)
    var mark = marks[pid]
    if (!mark || !line) return
    var bubble = cfg.paragraph ? qmBubbleImage.call(ctx, 'paragraph', bid, cid, pid, mark.count, mark.hot ? '热门段评' : '七猫段评', mark.gid, mark.hot) : ''
    if (bubble) lines[index] += bubble
    var god = cfg.god ? qmGodImage.call(ctx, bid, cid, pid, mark.gid, mark.gtxt) : ''
    if (god) lines[index] += '\n' + god
  })
  if (cfg.chapter) try { var chapterBubble = qmBubbleImage.call(ctx, 'chapter', bid, cid, '', qmChapterReviewCount.call(ctx, bid, cid), '本章说'); if (chapterBubble) lines.push(chapterBubble) } catch (chapterError) {}
  if (cfg.book) try { var bookBubble = qmBubbleImage.call(ctx, 'book', bid, '', '', qmBookReviewCount.call(ctx, bid), '本书书评'); if (bookBubble) lines.push(bookBubble) } catch (bookError) {}
  return lines.join('\n')
}

function qmContentTitle(value, baseUrl) {
  var text = String(value || '')
  var runtimeChapter = qmChapterOf(this)
  try { if (runtimeChapter) runtimeChapter.putImgUrl(null) } catch (e) {}
  return text
}

function qmReadContent(text, baseUrl) {
  if (/^data:;base64,/.test(String(baseUrl)) && /["']type["']\s*:\s*["']video["']/.test(String(baseUrl))) {
    return qmHexDecodeAscii(text)
  }
  if (String(baseUrl).indexOf('/playlet/api/info') >= 0) {
    var video = qmParse(text).data || {}
    var playList = video.play_list || []
    var sort = qmUrlValue(baseUrl, 'qm_sort')
    var runtimeChapter = qmChapterOf(this)
    if (!sort) {
      try {
        var titleMatch = String(runtimeChapter && runtimeChapter.title || '').match(/第\s*(\d+)\s*集/)
        if (titleMatch) sort = titleMatch[1]
      } catch (titleError) {}
    }
    var item = playList.filter(function (x) { return sort && String(x.sort) == String(sort) })[0]
    if (!item) {
      var chapterIndex = -1
      try { chapterIndex = Number(runtimeChapter && runtimeChapter.index) } catch (indexError) {}
      if (chapterIndex >= 0) item = playList[chapterIndex]
    }
    if (!item) item = playList.filter(function (x) { return !!(x.video_url || x.video_url_h265) })[0] || {}
    return String(item.video_url || item.video_url_h265 || '')
  }
  if (String(baseUrl).indexOf('/album/info') >= 0) {
    var audio = qmParse(text).data || {}
    var voices = audio.voice_list || []
    return voices.length ? String(voices[0].voice_url) : '本集暂无可播放音频'
  }
  return qmNovelContent.call(this, text, baseUrl)
}

<js>
(function() {
    // 1. 判断是否是标签搜索
    function isTagSearch(key) {
        return /^(tag|标签)[:：]/.test(key);
    }
  
    if (isTagSearch(key)) {
        java.longToast('🔍 正在使用标签搜索（菠萝猫搜索）');
        var tag = key.replace(/^(tag|标签)[:：]/, '').trim();
        var baseUrl = 'https://www.boluomao.com/tag/' + java.encodeURI(tag) + '/';
        return page > 1 ? baseUrl + 'page/' + page + '/' : baseUrl;
    }

    // 2. 关键词搜索逻辑 (通过缓存和 rrssk.com 动态签名)
    var cacheKey = "rrssk_find_url_" + java.md5Encode(key);
    var targetUrl = cache.get(cacheKey);

    if (!targetUrl) {
        java.longToast('🔍 正在安全连接并检索书籍...');
        var window = {};
      
        // 获取中转页 HTML
        var resHtml = java.get('https://www.rrssk.com/boluomao.html', {
            "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36",
            "Referer": "https://www.rrssk.com/"
        }).body();

        // 提取 _t
        var tMatch = resHtml.match(/name="_t"\s+value="([^"]+)"/);
        if (!tMatch) {
            throw new Error("无法从中转页获取到签名令牌(_t)");
        }
        var tVal = tMatch[1];

        // 依次执行所有内联 script，加载签名函数及可能用到的加密工具函数
        var scriptRegex = /<script[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/gi;
        var match;
        var foundSign = false;
        while ((match = scriptRegex.exec(resHtml)) !== null) {
            var code = match[1];
            if (code && code.trim().length > 0) {
                try {
                    eval(code);
                    if (code.indexOf("__SIGN") !== -1) {
                        foundSign = true;
                    }
                } catch(e) {
                    // 忽略部分因缺少浏览器DOM环境引起的无害报错
                }
            }
        }

        if (!foundSign || !window.__SIGN || typeof window.__SIGN.f !== 'function') {
            throw new Error("未能成功初始化动态签名算法，请反馈至作者维护");
        }

        // 与 PHP rawurlencode 完全一致的 RFC3986 编码
        function __enc(x) {
            return encodeURIComponent(x).replace(/[!'()*]/g, function(c) {
                return '%' + c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16).toUpperCase();
            });
        }

        var ts = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
        var s = window.__SIGN.f(__enc(key), tVal, ts);

        // 构造载荷提交 POST 搜索请求
        var postData = "action=search&_t=" + tVal + "&_ts=" + ts + "&_s=" + s + "&keyword=" + java.encodeURI(key);
        var postRes = java.post("https://www.rrssk.com/?action=search", postData, {
            "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded",
            "Referer": "https://www.rrssk.com/boluomao.html",
            "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"
        });

        // 获取最终的 find 重定向页面地址
        targetUrl = postRes.url().toString();

        if (!targetUrl || targetUrl.indexOf("action=find") === -1) {
            var loc = postRes.header("Location");
            if (loc) {
                if (!loc.startsWith("http")) {
                    targetUrl = "https://www.rrssk.com" + (loc.startsWith("/") ? "" : "/") + loc;
                } else {
                    targetUrl = loc;
                }
            }
        }

        if (!targetUrl || targetUrl.indexOf("action=find") === -1) {
            throw new Error("未能进入有效的搜索结果页面，请尝试重新搜索");
        }

        // 规范化 URL，剔除原有 page 参数以供后续动态翻页拼接
        targetUrl = targetUrl.replace(/[&?]page=\d+/g, "");
        cache.put(cacheKey, targetUrl, 300); // 结果地址写入缓存 (有效期 5 分钟)
    }

    var conn = targetUrl.indexOf("?") !== -1 ? "&" : "?";
    return targetUrl + conn + "page=" + page;
})()
</js>

【话本小说 · 使用说明】(本书源基于 Legado MD3 版本制作调试)

■ 这是什么
话本小说网(www.ihuaben.com)书源, 以同人/原创小说为主, 免费在线阅读。

■ 搜索说明
1. 支持书名/作者搜索(话本站内搜索 so.ihuaben.com)
2. 注意: 话本是同人/原创平台, 没有主流网文(如斗破苍穹等搜不到属正常)
3. 若开「精确搜索」, 只返回书名与关键词完全一致的结果

■ 发现页(5个榜单)
点击榜 / 评论榜 / 收藏榜 / 新书榜 / 新手村, 各100条

■ 正文阅读
1. 章节开头的角色对话已排版为「头像+名字：台词」(模拟聊天, 线性排列)
2. 已自动清除: 评论数字徽标、段评、作者语(角色对话保留)
3. 正文插图已保留; 文字嵌入模式下头像按文字行高显示(较小)

■ MD3版本注意事项
1. 若换书后图片样式未生效: 从书架删除该书重新加入
2. 首次打开较长的书, 目录页(全量章节)加载略慢属正常
3. 图片排版受Legado MD3文本阅读器限制: 图片只能「小尺寸内联同行」或「大尺寸独占一行」, 无法像原网站聊天气泡那样左右分栏

网站的书都是用户上传，你也可去网站上传
【技术实现】
搜索：HTML 搜索（GET /search.php?q=）
发现：CSS 选择器（library.php 分页）
详情：CSS 选择器（详情页与目录同页）
目录：CSS 选择器（chapter-chip）
正文：CSS@html + JS 解码，反爬字符自动还原
登录：POST 表单登录（loginUi + loginUrl，Cookie 持久化）

【局限性】
- 网站有 GOEDGE WAF 防护，必须使用移动端 UA 请求头

        for (var i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {

        var efi = data.efi;

        var tingId = data.id;

        function decryptEfi(efi, tingId, creationTime) {
            var tingClean = tingId.replace(/-/g, '');
            var timeStr = creationTime.replace(/-/g, '').replace(/:/g, '').replace(/T/g, '').replace(/\./g, '').replace(/ /g, '');
            var timePadded = timeStr.padEnd(20, '0');

            function gk(t, tm) {
                var r = '';
                for (var i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
                    r += String.fromCharCode(t.charCodeAt(i) + Number(tm[i]));
                }
                for (var i = 20; i < t.length; i++) {
                    r += String.fromCharCode(t.charCodeAt(i) + Number(tm[i - 20]));
                }
                return r;
            }
            function gi(t, tm) {
                var r = '';
                for (var i = 20; i > 4; i--) {
                    r += String.fromCharCode(t.charCodeAt(i) + Number(tm[i - 1]));
                }
                return r;
            }

            var keyStr = gk(tingClean, timePadded);
            var ivStr = gi(tingClean, timePadded);
            var keyB64 = java.base64Encode(keyStr);
            var ivB64 = java.base64Encode(ivStr);

            var keyBytes = java.base64DecodeToByteArray(keyB64);
            var ivBytes = java.base64DecodeToByteArray(ivB64);
            var ciphertext = java.base64DecodeToByteArray(efi);
            var secretKey = javax.crypto.spec.SecretKeySpec(keyBytes, "AES");
            var ivSpec = javax.crypto.spec.IvParameterSpec(ivBytes);
            var cipher = javax.crypto.Cipher.getInstance("AES/CBC/PKCS5Padding");
            cipher.init(javax.crypto.Cipher.DECRYPT_MODE, secretKey, ivSpec);
            var plainBytes = cipher.doFinal(ciphertext);
            var plainText = new Packages.java.lang.String(plainBytes, "UTF-8");
            return plainText;
        }

        var decrypted = decryptEfi(efi, tingId, creationTime);
        var audioPath = '';
        try {
            var resultObj = JSON.parse(decrypted);
            audioPath = resultObj.url || resultObj.audioUrl || resultObj.playUrl || '';
        } catch(e) {
            audioPath = decrypted;
        }
        if (audioPath) {

            }
        } else {

        }
    } catch(e) {

    }
}

else {

(function() {
let novelId = java.hexDecodeToString(result)
let type = JSON.parse(baseUrl.slice(baseUrl.indexOf('{'))).type

if (type == 'novel') {
  book.type = 8
  let loginInfo = JSON.parse(source.getLoginInfo() || '{}')
  loginInfo.书籍ID = novelId
  source.putLoginInfo(JSON.stringify(loginInfo))
} else if (type == 'comic') {
  book.type = 64
} else if (type == 'audio') {
  book.type = 32
}

// 主目录和普通章节仍走 qd.vv9v.cn；彩蛋只走 qdApi/qdList。
let catalog = requestApiUrl(`/${type}/catalog`, { novelId }) || []

let midpageEnabled = false
let midpageEntries = []
try {
  let m = source.getLoginInfoMap ? source.getLoginInfoMap() : null
  let v = m && (m.get ? m.get("\u5f69\u86cb\u7ae0\u5f00\u5173") : m["\u5f69\u86cb\u7ae0\u5f00\u5173"])
  midpageEnabled = type === 'novel' && v != null && String(v) === "✅"
  let listFn = typeof qdList === 'function' ? qdList : function(x) { return Array.isArray(x) ? x : [] }
  if (midpageEnabled && typeof qdApi === 'function') {
    let midRes = qdApi.call(this, 'midpage_chapters', { book_id: novelId }) || {}
    let midData = midRes.data || midRes.Data || (midRes.raw && (midRes.raw.Data || midRes.raw.data)) || {}
    let midpageList = listFn(midData.Chapters || midData.chapters || midData.DataList || midData.MidpageChapters || midData.MidPageChapters)
    for (let mp of midpageList) {
      mp = mp || {}
      let targetId = mp.ChapterId || mp.C || mp.chapterId
      if (!targetId) continue
      let eggs = listFn(mp.MidpageList || mp.MidPageList || mp.PageList || mp.Pages || mp.List)
      if (!eggs.length) continue
      for (let egg of eggs) {
        try {
          egg = egg || {}
          let cfg = egg.MidPageConfig || egg.MidpageConfig || {}
          let eggName = egg.MidPageName || egg.MidpageName || egg.Title || egg.RoleName || cfg.PageName || cfg.Title || "彩蛋内容"
          eggName = String(eggName).replace(/[\r\n]+/g, ' ').replace(/^彩蛋章[ ·]*/, '')
          let midpageId = egg.PageId || egg.MidPageId || egg.MidpageId || cfg.PageId || cfg.MidPageId || ''
          if (!midpageId) continue
          let chapterId = String(targetId)
          midpageId = String(midpageId)
          let eggKey = 'midpage:' + String(novelId) + ':' + chapterId + ':' + midpageId
          let eggUrl = `data:;base64,${java.base64Encode(String(eggKey))},{"type":"novel","novelId":"${String(novelId)}","chapterId":"${chapterId}","qimoType":"midpage","midpageId":"${midpageId}"}`
          midpageEntries.push({
            id: eggKey,
            name: '彩蛋章 · ' + eggName,
            url: String(eggUrl),
            info: '官方插图/视频',
            isVolume: false,
            isVip: false,
            isPay: false
          })
        } catch (entryError) {
          try { java.log('忽略异常彩蛋数据: ' + entryError.message) } catch (_) {}
        }
      }
    }
  }
} catch (e) {
  midpageEnabled = false
  midpageEntries = []
  try { java.log('彩蛋 qdApi 处理失败，忽略彩蛋：' + e.message) } catch (_) {}
}

let cache = (requestApiUrl(`/${type}/cache`, { novelId }) || []).reduce((acc, d) => {
  acc[d.chapId] = d
  return acc
}, {})

function fmtTime(timestamp) {
  let date = new Date(timestamp)
  let year = date.getFullYear()
  let month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')
  let day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')
  let hours = String(date.getHours()).padStart(2, '0')
  let minutes = String(date.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')
  return `${year}-${month}-${day} ${hours}:${minutes}`
}

let chaps = []
if (type === 'novel') {
  for (let volumeIndex = 0; volumeIndex < catalog.length; volumeIndex++) {
    let volume = catalog[volumeIndex] || {}
    let volumeKey = 'volume:' + String(novelId) + ':' + String(volumeIndex)
    chaps.push({
      id: volumeKey,
      name: volume.volumeName,
      url: `data:;base64,${java.base64Encode(volumeKey)},{"type":"volume"}`,
      isVolume: true
    })
    for (let chapter of (volume.chapters || [])) {
      let { chapId, chapName, charCount, isVip, isBuy, displayTime } = chapter
      let isShare = cache[chapId]
      chaps.push({
        id: chapId,
        name: (isVip ? (isBuy ? ' 🔑 ' : isShare ? '  🍋 ' : '') : '') + chapName,
        url: `data:;base64,${java.base64Encode(chapId)},{"type":"${type}","novelId":"${novelId}"}`,
        info: `${fmtTime(displayTime)} | ${charCount || 0}字 ${isShare ? '  🍋 ' : isBuy ? ' 🔑 ' : ''}`,
        isVip: !isShare && isVip,
        isPay: !!isBuy,
      })

    }
  }
}

if (midpageEnabled && midpageEntries.length) {
  let midpageVolumeKey = 'volume:' + String(novelId) + ':midpage'
  chaps.push({
    id: midpageVolumeKey,
    name: '彩蛋章',
    url: `data:;base64,${java.base64Encode(midpageVolumeKey)},{"type":"volume"}`,
    isVolume: true
  })
  chaps = chaps.concat(midpageEntries)
}

return JSON.stringify(chaps)
})();
